description: Render a tool's stored resultTemplate/handoffUrl against sample data — the same renderer execute uses on a real submission — without calling the client's endpoint. Falls back to the tool's stored sampleOutput (parsed as JSON when it parses) when sampleResponse is omitted. Check missingKeys is empty before calling tool_publish — a non-empty list means the template references a field the sample (or the client's real response) doesn't have, which will render blank for every real visitor. The returned html is truncated to 4000 characters (htmlTruncated flags this) — the full rendered page is what visitors see live; this is for spot-checking the template.

sampleInputs.description: Sample visitor form values, for {{input.<key>}} placeholders. Defaults to {}.

sampleResponse.description: A sample of the client endpoint's JSON response, used to render resultTemplate/handoffUrl. Falls back to the tool's stored sampleOutput when omitted.

name: tool_preview
